steps.content: It has been a week since you last saw Bianca.
After the account Extra-Rich Apple Juice 2.0 was banned, Bianca opened several new accounts, but they were banned as well.

Bianca is becoming despondent. You're worried about her, but at the same time, you have a nagging feeling that this reporter, who has a tendency to go to extremes, might find another way to administer justice.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I observed injustice, I recorded it, I shouted it out for the world to hear. I've done all I can, but nothing has changed.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: No meaningful change has come of my efforts to expose them.

Bianca once accepted help from the Underground to solve her problem, and later punished herself for her choice to uphold justice. Now, facing setbacks, will she once again choose the "red pill" that might spell disaster for everyone?
Now faced with insurmountable difficulties, will she persevere?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, are you listening?
Nightingale's voice pulls you out of your trance.
Please continue. Where were we?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We were talking about the follow-up handling of the Cohen factory case.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The FAC is taking charge of the implementation of the action plan. Since this case involves Mania weapons, the handling of the Cohen Group cannot be made public. The FAC has also expressed a desire to cooperate with the Bureau in a covert operation aimed at learning the ins and outs of the entire supply chain.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Of course, this matter is still under discussion. We may talk with the FAC about other possible approaches, if you wish.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And here's another file I think that might interest you.
Nightingale places the file in front of you. Flipping it open, it's Bianca's PERF report, you realize.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: A few days ago, Sinner Bianca submitted an application to leave the premises for the Rust and continue her unfinished investigation there. It was refused, of course, since the FAC had already taken over the case.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: After her first application was refused, she continued to apply, submitting three applications a day, and she also submitted an application for computer use.
Nightingale sends you a familiar website address.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Intelligence Department has recorded her browsing history.
A Chronicle of Mania Weapons Trafficking, posted by... King of Apples?
You click on the account ID. As you scroll down, more posts pop up. All the recent posts are related to the Cohen case.
Each post only has a moderate number of views, but the poster is very active, posting frequently.

[Shocking Revelation! Cohen Group Involved in Forbidden Weapons Trafficking!] 
Poster: King of Apples
Views: 2k+ Comments: 23

[Revelation! Cohen Group Secretly Trades in Mania Weapons! Utterly Conscienceless!]
Poster: King of Apples
Views: 4k+ Comments: 52

[Into DisCity's Dark Side. Latest Revelation! Cohen Group Continues to Trade in Mania Weapons!]
Poster: King of Apples
Views: 694 Comments: 9

...
You scroll down to the latest post, from just three hours ago, titled Assemble for Justice! Volunteers Wanted! Expose Cohen Group at Press Conference!

<color=#fb9259>King of Apples</color>: Thank you for your support. Unfortunately, this account will soon be shut down as well, and you might not be able to contact me anymore. But Apple Juice will never give up! o(~ヘ~o#)
<color=#fb9259>King of Apples</color>: The Cohen Group is holding a press conference in front of their headquarters at three this afternoon. I'd like to invite you to join me in further exposing their crimes. No registration necessary! If you want to participate, just go to the venue at three this afternoon. My friends, let's go bring the Cohen Group to justice!
<color=#fb9259>King of Apples</color>: Keep an eye out for the apple icon! I'll be back on the forum with a new account. See you soon!
The user has an apple as their avatar. You know who the user is.
Did Bianca post all these?
You knew Bianca would take action, but you didn't expect her to go to such extraordinary lengths.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes, and I've just received a message from the Intelligence Department saying that Bianca has probably set off.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That was an unauthorized leave of absence. The MBCC should take action to bring the Sinner back, but...
Noticing your hesitation, Nightingale smiles and hands you the file she's holding.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Or maybe you prefer to go there in person.

You arrive at the plaza outside the Cohen Building. It's not quite three o'clock. The plaza is bustling with people, some passing by, others standing around on the periphery looking this way and that.
These people must have come here after reading Bianca's posts...

As time goes by, the crowd in front of the Cohen Building grows in size. Murmured conversations sprout up here and there. Curious passersby, unaware of what is going on, stop to ask why so many people have gathered here.
Suddenly, the crowd stirs. A few business persons in exquisite suits are walking out of the building. They take their places around the podium.

steps.speaker: Cohen Group Spokesperson
steps.content: Friends from the media and other works of life, we have recently become aware of certain rumors circulating online alleging that the Cohen Group is involved in the trafficking of Mania weapons. We are deeply shocked and dismayed by these baseless accusations...

steps.speaker: Cohen Group Spokesperson
steps.content: We want to reiterate that the Cohen Group has never engaged in selling or buying any illegal weapons. We will never stray from our commitment to conduct all business dealings within the confines of the law and with high integrity, and to make a greater contribution to DisCity's prosperity!
The man drones on with more platitudes. You search the crowd for Bianca, but don't see her.
Over here! I have a question!
You turn to the source of the voice. A blonde reporter has her right hand held high. It's Bianca!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Hello, I'm a reporter from Minos TV. I understand your anger at the rumors being spread on the internet about your company. To put these rumors to rest, I went to the locations mentioned in that post and captured something interesting on film.
The face of the man standing at the podium falls, while Bianca's smile becomes brighter.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: No need to thank me. I was just trying to find evidence to prove your company's innocence.

Bianca points at the big screen mounted high on the exterior of the building with her right hand. Everyone turns to look. A mere second later, the screen displays the dim interior of a factory by the Rust.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Take a look, everyone! What you see on the screen is the main workshop of a Cohen factory, not open to the public. I suppose that's where they treat industrial waste. See that huge conveyor belt over there? It's used to transport industrial waste to the place where it can be treated, purified and then discharged...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: As you all know, the Rust is a huge source of Mania. Some people take advantage of this fact to line their pockets.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ah, I set out to clear your name. It's a pity I didn't succeed in that task. Still, I intend to show my friends here the truth I've discovered.
The camera zooms in on the assembly line, where Mania weapons are being made and sent to various destinations.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Who is at fault? I believe the answer is clear now.
The crowd falls silent. A second later, it erupts.

steps.speaker: Civilian A
steps.content: Damn you, Cohen! Man up and admit it!

steps.speaker: Civilian B
steps.content: Wait a second, isn't Cohen a clean energy company? Why would they dirty their hands with Mania?

steps.speaker: Civilian C
steps.content: **** you, Cohen! Turns out you're the reason why Mania is spreading, you selfish, black-hearted money-grabber!

steps.speaker: Cohen Group Spokesperson
steps.content: Please calm down! We can explain—

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: We don't want to hear empty words. Don't treat us like fools!
A deafening cacophony of voices whooping and hollering fills the air, as the crowd surges forward. At the very front is that familiar golden-haired girl, leading the others in a chant.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: "Choose the blue pill, you may be able to destroy Gray Mirror, but you'll have to keep on fighting the countless invisible enemies on Red Mirror, White Mirror, and Blue Mirror? Or choose the red pill, you'll open the magic box, release the malice within, and see how it would end for it and its owners?"

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I know you'd choose the blue pill, Ashy. Hehe, too bad I'm not you. I have neither magical powers nor strong connections. My legs go weak at the sight of monsters and I always fail in obtaining information. But there are things even I can't tolerate. So, my answer is quite obvious, isn't it?
This time she is not the Gray Mirror administrator who sat in judgment from afar. She has chosen to be in the thick of it among the others to defend justice, to bring the truth to light.
Looks like you're no longer needed here.
As you leave by shouldering your way through the moving crowd, you hear that familiar voice again.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: For truth and justice!
Bianca has chosen to continue fighting as a reporter. As the Chief of the MBCC, you decide to do something to further her cause.
No sooner have you arrived back at the MBCC than Bianca comes to talk with you.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ashy! Chief! ${PlayerName}! You're finally back!
Bianca shoves her phone in your face.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: This! Did you do it?

steps.speaker: DisCity Today
steps.content: Breaking news: The Cohen Group is suspected of Mania weapons trafficking and manufacturing. All business activities of its factories have been suspended!

steps.speaker: Eastside Midday News
steps.content: The FAC confirmed the veracity of the rumors this morning. The spokesperson has stated that the incident is still under investigation, and the areas involved have all been sealed off...
There is no need to hide it from Bianca, so you nod.
What are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You know what I'm talking about. This whole Cohen thing didn't make much sense to me at first. Sure, I exposed the Cohen Group, but that wouldn't have been enough to convince all those people to come forward. That's when I realized someone high up in the power structure must have gotten involved, someone like you...
Bianca's guess is basically correct. You decide to come clean.
You guessed right.
Well, actually, I asked Super Apple for help.
Super Apple said he had been looking for criminals who disturbed the city's peace, but due to a lack of reliable clues, he couldn't pinpoint who and where these troublemakers were.
steps.female_content: Super Apple said she had been looking for criminals who disturbed the city's peace, but due to a lack of reliable clues, she couldn't pinpoint who and where these troublemakers were.

steps.content: So I gave the clues you found to Super Apple, and I asked him to reason with them, to convince them to bring those vermin's evil deeds to light. Having their reputation ruined is what those despicable people deserve, and they deserve a far more severe punishment considering what they have done.
steps.female_content: So I gave the clues you found to Super Apple, and I asked her to reason with them, to convince them to bring those vermin's evil deeds to light. Having their reputation ruined is what those despicable people deserve, and they deserve a far more severe punishment considering what they have done.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: The FAC was willing to sit down and listen to Super Apple?
Yes, they even asked Super Apple to help catch the bad guys.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ah, is Super Apple, by any chance, <color=#fb9259>${PlayerName}</color>?
Bianca raises a playful eyebrow, a clear sign that she's not buying your story at all.
If you don't believe me, then go investigate.
Go do what you're best at. Find the truth, expose those at fault, and make them receive the punishment they deserve.

You pat Bianca on the shoulder. As you make for your office, Nightingale sends you a message saying that the FAC has had the situation under control, and that there's been no overly strong public reaction. The exposure of the Cohen Group represents a victory for justice.
By the way, Super Apple asked me to tell you this.

Upholding justice and seeking the truth is no easy task. It was because of your insistence on finding the truth that those bad guys got the punishment they deserved. Thank you for not giving up and for choosing the side of justice.
Well, I'm meeting him later today. Is there anything you want to say to him? I can take a message for you.
steps.female_content: Well, I'm meeting her later today. Is there anything you want to say to her? I can take a message for you.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Pff.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I'm good, thanks. If I have something to tell him, I'll go tell him in person, but not until I've caught all the bad guys.
steps.female_content: I'm good, thanks. If I have something to tell her, I'll go tell her in person, but not until I've caught all the bad guys.

steps.speaker: Little Bianca
steps.content: Hello! Miss Reporter with the apple headband...

steps.speaker: Little Bianca
steps.content: Were you daydreaming again? I was saying that I wanted to become an awesome reporter too. I want to catch bad guys with you!

steps.speaker: Little Bianca
steps.content: And did you find the bad guys in the end? Did Super Apple defeat them?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I did!

As long as this city remains standing, there will always be darkness lurking somewhere. We must do our best to stop it from expanding. Discover the truth, expose evil deeds, defend justice alongside those who want to have their voices heard. Don't become part of the darkness. Be the light that dispels the darkness. Observe it, record it, shout it out for the world to hear. Things may not end in the way I hope, but I believe that my efforts can bring about changes.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: At least I can serve as a starting point...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: A starting point that has many imperfections but is full of possibilities...
